title: Coherent RFRS groups
summary: We prove that a finitely generated virtually RFRS group of cohomological dimension at most $2$ is coherent if and only if its second $L^{2}$-Betti number vanishes if and only if it is virtually free-by-cyclic. The non-vanishing of the second $L^{2}$-Betti number provides the first known global obstruction to coherence in any reasonably wide class of groups, allowing for proofs of incoherence without needing to exhibit explicit witnesses to incoherence.
